<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InformationRequest" name="Request for visa information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepresentationInformation" name="Visa information and additional document requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent Austrian representation or other competent issuing office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformationRequest" name="Request information" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_InformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Information" name="Provide information" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" messageRef="Message_RepresentationInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Submit application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Return decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanningSplit" name="Plan both arrangements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeBankAccount" name="Negotiate bank account"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanningJoin" name="Arrangements planned"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineOffice" name="Determine applicable procedure and competent office">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check whether the intended application concerns a visa or a Rot-Weiss-Rot Card; do not assume they are the same procedure. Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad, with specified exceptional cases at certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, state police headquarters. For a type D visa, apply at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence is based on the applicant's place of residence (centre of interest). For category A or C visas, use the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. For a Schengen visa, determine the main travel destination; if stays are equal, determine it by length and purpose, and if no main destination can be determined, use the country of first entry. A representation may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district when the applicant justifies the choice of consulate.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact representation in advance" messageRef="Message_InformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInformation" name="Receive information and document requirements" messageRef="Message_RepresentationInformation"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare requested additional documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Additional documents may be requested depending on the circumstances. Evidence can vary by location and may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket, or proof of gainful employment.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" name="Continue document preparation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" name="Prepare application requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check that the travel document is valid in Austria, was issued within the last ten years, has at least two empty pages, and remains valid for at least three months beyond the visa duration.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of stay, with cover of at least 30,000 Euro and validity throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" name="Prepare other required evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare evidence requested by the relevant authorities, taking account of local requirements and coordination with other Schengen representations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EvidenceJoin" name="Application requirements prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive visa decision" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Was the application approved?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForRenewal" name="Wait until the next application interval">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Renewal">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P${x}M</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Denied" name="Application not approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_PlanningSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_OrganizeBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningJoin_DetermineOffice" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineOffice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineOffice_Contact" sourceRef="Task_DetermineOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_Information" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Information_AdditionalDocuments" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditionalDocuments_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_EvidenceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceSplit_OtherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherEvidence_EvidenceJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvidenceJoin_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_EvidenceJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Event_WaitForRenewal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${applicationApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Denied">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not applicationApproved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Contact" sourceRef="Event_WaitForRenewal" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo measuring 35 x 45 mm in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of the stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro and validity throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for absence of other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" name="Visa application requirements prepared"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Visa application submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_PlanningSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_Accommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_Bank" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accommodation_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningJoin_CheckAuthorization" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckAuthorizationRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAuthorization_DetermineOffice" sourceRef="Task_CheckAuthorizationRequirements" targetRef="Task_DetermineIssuingOffice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineOffice_Contact" sourceRef="Task_DetermineIssuingOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_ReceiveInformation" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInformation_AdditionalDocuments" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditionalDocuments_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocumentsMerge_RequirementsSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsJoin_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_End" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationSubmitted"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InformationRequest" name="Request for visa information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RequirementsInformation" name="Visa information and document requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant" processRef="Process_WorkLiveAustria"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Competent representation or other competent issuing office"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InformationRequest" name="Request information in advance" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_InformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequirementsInformation" name="Provide visa information and document requirements" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" messageRef="Message_RequirementsInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VisaApplication" name="Submit visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin planning"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanningSplit" name="Organize accommodation, bank account, and visa matters"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyAccommodation" name="Identify an accommodation option"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" name="Negotiate accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyBankAccount" name="Identify a bank account option"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" name="Negotiate a bank account"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckVisaCardRequirements" name="Check visa and Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements every x months">
      <bpmn:documentation>The description specifies a recurring interval of x months but does not state the value of x. The detailed requirements provided concern visas; specific Rot-Weiss-Rot Card requirements are not provided.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PlanningJoin" name="Accommodation, bank account, and visa matters addressed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineIssuingOffice" name="Determine the competent visa issuing office">
      <bpmn:documentation>Generally, visas are issued by representation offices abroad. In specific exceptional cases, certain border control posts may issue visas, and state police headquarters may do so where visa extension is permitted. Type D visas must be applied for at the competent Austrian representation; territorial competence is based on the foreign national's place of residence or centre of interest, which may be verified by registration forms, a residence permit, or a visa. For category A and C applications, territorial competence falls to the representation in the consular district of the applicant's legal place of residence. A representation may exceptionally accept an application from a third-country national legally residing but not registered in its district if the applicant justifies applying to that consulate. For Schengen visas, the competent representation is that of the country of the main travel destination. If equal time is spent in several countries, determine the main destination based on the length and purpose of the stay; if no main destination can be determined, the country of first entry into the Schengen area is responsible. The BMEIA website lists representation office addresses, telephone numbers, opening hours, and special requirements.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactRepresentation" name="Contact the representation in advance" messageRef="Message_InformationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInformation" name="Receive visa information and document requirements" messageRef="Message_RequirementsInformation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" name="Are additional documents requested?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" name="Prepare requested additional documents">
      <bpmn:documentation>Depending on the circumstances, additional documents may be requested. Evidence requirements may vary by location and may include hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, a return flight ticket, or proof of gainful employment.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" name="Continue application preparation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" name="Prepare visa application requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>The travel document must be valid in Austria, have been issued within the last ten years, have at least two empty pages, and remain valid for at least three months beyond the duration of the visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePhoto" name="Prepare passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare a portrait-format photo measuring 35 x 45 mm in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainInsurance" name="Obtain travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide fully comprehensive travel health insurance for the planned duration of the stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro and validity throughout the Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProveMeans" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Provide proof of sufficient means for the intended stay and the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" name="Check for other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for absence of other grounds for refusal, including a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" name="Visa application requirements prepared"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Visa application submitted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_PlanningSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_IdentifyAccommodation" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_IdentifyAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyAccommodation_NegotiateAccommodation" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyAccommodation" targetRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiateAccommodation_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_IdentifyBankAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_IdentifyBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyBankAccount_NegotiateBankAccount" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyBankAccount" targetRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiateBankAccount_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateBankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningSplit_CheckVisaCard" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckVisaCardRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckVisaCard_PlanningJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckVisaCardRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanningJoin_DetermineOffice" sourceRef="Gateway_PlanningJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineIssuingOffice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineOffice_Contact" sourceRef="Task_DetermineIssuingOffice" targetRef="Task_ContactRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Contact_ReceiveInformation" sourceRef="Task_ContactRepresentation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInformation_AdditionalDocuments" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInformation" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocuments_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalDocuments" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAdditionalDocuments_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAdditionalDocuments" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalDocumentsMerge_RequirementsSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDocumentsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Form" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_TravelDocument" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Photo" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ObtainInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_Means" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProveMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsSplit_RefusalGrounds" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Form_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompleteApplicationForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelDocument_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Photo_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_PreparePhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ObtainInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Means_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProveMeans" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefusalGrounds_RequirementsJoin" sourceRef="Task_CheckRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequirementsJoin_Submit" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_End" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
